invariants.rule: All records remain quarantined unless explicitly promoted through publication gates.
Every record must have a unique DV-REC-###### ID and matching filename prefix.
Every record must have source_packet, provenance, safety, review, and links blocks.
Every record source_id must exist in SOURCE-LEDGER.json and have a source card unless explicitly structural-only.
Source-card dependent_record_ids are recomputed from record source packets, not manually trusted.
No public records, private testimony, clinical advice surface, ritual instruction surface, or prognosis/countdown surface is enabled.
record_classes and axis arrays must not contain duplicate values after normalization.
The current ontology is a scaffold; lints enforce integrity but must not freeze conceptual exploration.
Public revision zips contain no raw private testimony, raw private transcripts, contact details, consent signatures, or identifying testimony casefiles.
Fieldwork dry-run surfaces do not authorize real recruitment, real testimony collection, or public quotes.
